0022600189.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-6, 11th in the East and 3.5 games back in the Central) face the Denver Nuggets (4-3, 9th in the West and 2 games back in the Northwest) in the NBA Mexico City Game at a neutral site in Mexico City, with Indiana coming off a win and Denver also riding a win. Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Kelly Oubre Jr. is day-to-day with a calf bruise and a game-time decision, while Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and DeMar DeRozan is day-to-day with back spasms and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Pacers lost their 2025-26 season series 0-2, including a 135-120 defeat in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025.
